body:
This draft hardens the authentication template and adds disposable API/browser fixtures. It covers feature pruning, English/Arabic lifecycle and accessibility, role pagination/filtering, current API contracts and CI/Compose/nginx configuration.

Bounded independent rechecks accepted FR001–FR003, GR001–GR007, CI-COMB-01, HFR001/HFR002, responsive header/skip-link sizing, the localized SSR probe contract, and the 320px sessions wrapping/focus repairs. Full labels and controls remain available; cancel and Escape return focus to the existing dialog trigger.

[CI run 34232151880](https://github.com/Mohammed-Abdelhady/nextjs-nestjs-oauth-rbac-boilerplate/actions/runs/34232151880) passed all four functional jobs on `9e502f9ee0e36c8f9c164fc05a03161c689f374f` on 2026-09-08:

- Quality: lint, types, production builds, backend 708/708, frontend 123/123, CLI 107/107 and configuration 65/65.
- Scaffold combinations: 9/9 across seven generated selections.
- Integration: API 72/72, anonymous browsers 44/44 and authenticated browsers 78/78. All 122 browser cases passed with zero failed, skipped or flaky cases.
- Docker: images built, all four services became healthy, and the five required HTTP checks passed before owned-fixture cleanup. The success log follows validation of the exact backend-health, nginx-health, English SSR, Arabic SSR and advertised-method result set; individual response bodies are not logged.

The earlier official Node 22 fresh install ran lifecycle scripts and preserved the lockfile. Local final checks and genuine commit/pre-push hooks also passed. Per-case real login follows deterministic database resets; reusable storageState is not claimed. Browser fixtures remain maintainer-only; generated projects retain functional API and product unit tests.

**NOT READY for release.** The [CodeQL analysis job](https://github.com/Mohammed-Abdelhady/nextjs-nestjs-oauth-rbac-boilerplate/actions/runs/34232151876) passed, but its separate PR security gate failed. Current-head summary metadata reports 31 untriaged alerts (30 high, one medium); no alert details were investigated. The independent security review remains blocked by the existing explicit control rejection. All 137 historical audit rows retain their qualified dispositions; they are not 137 independently closed findings.

Hosted evidence establishes the synthetic HTTP/container fixture, not production TLS/certificate renewal, live provider accounts, delivered mail or hardware passkeys. Previously denied local Docker/helper-listener operations were not retried. No merge, deployment or package publication occurred.

The [verification report](https://github.com/Mohammed-Abdelhady/nextjs-nestjs-oauth-rbac-boilerplate/blob/9e502f9ee0e36c8f9c164fc05a03161c689f374f/.hyperflow/reports/production-hardening.md) and [137-finding audit ledger](https://github.com/Mohammed-Abdelhady/nextjs-nestjs-oauth-rbac-boilerplate/blob/9e502f9ee0e36c8f9c164fc05a03161c689f374f/.hyperflow/reports/audit-status.md) record the dated pre-push boundary. This PR body records the subsequent hosted results above.
